manual: The music comes from the local model engine: install community-apps/omarchy-local-ai/install.sh first (Podman, ~8 GiB of ACE-Step weights). Without it Flowtunes shows its set-up screen.
Audio goes through Qt Multimedia's FFmpeg backend to PulseAudio / PipeWire.
Media keys and the bar's now-playing use MPRIS on the session D-Bus.
Corner rounding from Hyprland is skipped without HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE, so corners stay square on i3.
